description: This file declares functions related to optimization passes in the JIT compiler of PyTorch, specifically for fusing and folding convolutions with other operations like batch normalization, addition/subtraction, and multiplication/division in frozen computation graphs.

methods.name: FoldFrozenConvBatchnorm
methods.description: Fuses Convolution followed by Batchnorm into a single Convolution by folding batchnorm weights into conv weights.

methods.name: FoldFrozenConvAddOrSub
methods.description: Fuses Convolution followed by Add or Sub into a single Convolution by folding the add/sub constant tensor into convolution weights.

methods.name: FoldFrozenConvMulOrDiv
methods.description: Fuses Convolution followed by Mul or Div into a single Convolution by folding the multiplicative/divisive constant tensor into convolution weights.
